nodes.name: Settings
nodes.description: Central configuration class using Pydantic BaseSettings. Manages all Jarvis settings including LLM, STT/TTS, audio, wake word, workspace safety, Google, web search, memory, Telegram, and proactive monitors. Loads from .env file with JARVIS_ prefix.

nodes.name: get_settings
nodes.description: Returns singleton Settings instance. Creates new instance on first call.

nodes.name: reload_settings
nodes.description: Forces reload of Settings instance from environment. Used for testing or when env vars change.

nodes.name: ToolError
nodes.description: Exception raised by tool implementations when operations fail (e.g., path outside workspace, file too large, disabled features).

nodes.name: Toolbox
nodes.description: Coding tools surface for agent. Provides safe file operations, directory listing, grep search, file writing, and shell execution. All operations are scoped to workspace with path safety validation. Write and shell tools are gated by settings flags.

nodes.name: read_file
nodes.description: Reads a file from workspace with optional line slicing. Enforces MAX_FILE_BYTES (200KB) limit. Returns numbered lines.

nodes.name: list_dir
nodes.description: Lists directory contents, sorted with directories first. Hides dotfiles.

nodes.name: grep
nodes.description: Regex search across files with glob filtering. Returns up to MAX_GREP_MATCHES (200) results. Skips .pyc and .git files.

nodes.name: write_file
nodes.description: Writes content to file if JARVIS_ALLOW_WRITES is enabled. Creates parent directories.

nodes.name: run_shell
nodes.description: Executes shell command in workspace if JARVIS_ALLOW_SHELL is enabled. Blocks dangerous commands (rm -rf /, mkfs, fork bombs). Enforces timeout and output truncation.

nodes.name: Toolbox
nodes.description: Unified tool registry and dispatcher for all Jarvis tools. Routes tool calls to coding, web, memory, calendar, email, and notification handlers. Provides async dispatch method with error handling.

nodes.name: dispatch
nodes.description: Central async dispatcher for all tool calls. Routes to appropriate handler based on tool name. Returns error strings on failure.

nodes.name: TOOL_SCHEMAS
nodes.description: OpenAI-style function schemas for all 21 tools: coding (read_file, list_dir, grep, write_file, run_shell), web (web_search, fetch_page), memory (remember, recall, forget), calendar (list_events, create_event, update_event, find_free_slot), email (list_emails, read_email, draft_reply, send_email), and notify.

nodes.name: STT
nodes.description: Real-time speech-to-text powered by Mistral Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602. Provides <500ms transcription latency optimized for Apple Silicon (MPS) with bf16. Includes lazy loading, resampling to 16kHz, low-energy rejection, and hallucination filtering.

nodes.name: transcribe
nodes.description: Async transcription of PCM audio. Converts int16 to float32, resamples to 16kHz if needed, rejects low-energy audio (RMS < 0.001), and runs synchronous transcription in thread pool.

nodes.name: _get_device
nodes.description: Detects best available device for Voxtral inference. Priority: CUDA > MPS > CPU. Cached with lru_cache.

nodes.name: _load_voxtral
nodes.description: Loads Voxtral-Mini-4B model and processor once. Uses bf16 on MPS/CUDA, fp32 on CPU. Downloads ~8GB on first run. Cached globally.

nodes.name: _is_hallucination
nodes.description: Filters common STT hallucinations on silent/noisy input. Detects known garbage outputs (you, okay, thanks, etc.) and repeated single words.

nodes.name: test_voxtral_e2e
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for Voxtral TTS and STT. Tests device detection, TTS synthesis, STT transcription, phrase caching, and performance benchmarks.

nodes.name: test_voxtral_stt_e2e
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite focused on Voxtral STT. Tests device detection, transcription with synthetic audio, low-energy rejection, resampling from different sample rates, and performance benchmarks.

nodes.name: test_core_config
nodes.description: Unit tests for Settings configuration class. Tests defaults, environment variable overrides, reload functionality, telegram chat IDs parsing, and path expansion.

nodes.name: test_tools_registry
nodes.description: Unit tests for unified tool registry. Tests TOOL_SCHEMAS presence, unknown tool dispatch, and web search without API key.

nodes.name: test_tools_safety
nodes.description: Safety tests for coding toolbox. Tests workspace path escaping prevention, write permissions disabled by default, and writes enabled with flag.

nodes.name: test_voice_stt_voxtral
nodes.description: Unit tests for Voxtral STT with mocked model. Tests transcription, low-energy rejection, and resampling.
